### 1. The Runway & Net Burn Math
To achieve an **18-month runway** with **$650K in cash**, your average **Net Burn Rate** needs to be strictly managed at **~$36,111 per month** ($650,000 ÷ 18 months).

*   **Payroll/Headcount:** $158,000/month (approx. 90% of total expenses)
*   **Non-Payroll OpEx:** ~$18,111/month (remaining budget for software, rent, marketing, etc.)
*   **Total Gross Expenses:** ~$176,111/month

*(Note: If your $158K/month is currently your Net Burn, your runway would only be ~4 months. Assuming $158K is your gross payroll/operating burn aligns perfectly with the 18-month runway goal).*

> *"Beacon Health Tech maintains a strong capital position with $650K in cash and a clear, sustainable path to an 18-month runway. By keeping our payroll and headcount costs focused at $158K/month, we are able to manage our net burn to roughly $36K/month. This highly efficient, talent-focused budget leaves us with sufficient operational overhead while ensuring we have the 18 months of runway needed to execute our upcoming growth milestones."*
